name: release_train_github_app_writer_20261021
comment: ANCHOR: RELEASE_TRAIN_GITHUB_APP_WRITER_20261021 — release-train arming finding 3 (decision D2 (a)).
GitHubAppWriter mints a fresh 1-hour installation token per write (JWT RS256 signed with cryptography from
~/.config/tradeai/release_train/github-app.pem, mode 600, never logged; narrowed permissions; a wider token is
refused); git push publishes only the bound refs/heads/train/<id> with the token as an http.extraheader in
the child's GIT_CONFIG_* env (never argv or a config file); PR open/merge via the REST API. GITHUB_WRITES_STATUS
stays PROPOSED. Hermetic: test RSA key in tmp_path, mocked GitHub API, local bare repo.
